_comment: 提交到 awesome-dsh-plugin 的条目参考（字段取自 awesome-dsh-plugin.com/plugins.json 的真实结构）。字段名以该仓库 CONTRIBUTING / 现有条目为准，本文件只是抄写来源。
name: dsh-todolist

description.en: Sidebar todo list for DeepSeek Harness: today / this week / overdue / backlog grouping, recurring tasks (daily, chosen weekdays, monthly day, end date), a month-view calendar with a per-day checklist, category management, and one-line natural-language quick add. The same JSON file is readable and writable by the agent through a personal_todo tool.
description.zh: 侧栏待办清单：今天 / 本周 / 逾期 / 积压分组，循环任务（每天、每周多选周几、每月指定几号、结束日期），月视图日历与按天清单，分类管理，一句话自然语言添加；同一份数据通过 personal_todo 工具与 agent 互通。
